metadata.description: A bench of Justice BR Gavai and K Vinod Chandran prohibited Centre and states from taking any action that would result in loss of forest area until further orders. This act came in to force on December 1, 2023. Experts and citizens expressed concerns that modifications would facilitate the authorties to reroute restricted forest areas for public infrastructure and commercial uses.
